name: Hit Chance Bounds
description: Replaces vanilla's 5%-95% gameplay and Character Screen hit-chance caps with 0%-100%. Lower values and upper values must respectively match when customized.

patches.description: Allow the Character Screen to reach the patched 0% display lower bound
Set offensive display formatter lower bound to 0
Set offensive display calculation lower bound to 0
Set defensive display formatter lower bound to 0
Set offensive display formatter upper bound to 100
Set offensive display calculation upper bound to 100
Set defensive display formatter upper bound to 100
